scenes.title: Pregnancy News
scenes.summary: Waitress Eva shocks Chef Viktor Barinov, sous-chef Lyova, and young cook Denis by announcing to each of them in private that she is pregnant.

scenes.title: Thanking German
scenes.summary: Art director Vika Goncharova visits head chef German Land in his office to thank him for saving her from being fired by Dmitry Nagiyev.

scenes.title: Childhood Friend
scenes.summary: In the dining room, molecular-cuisine specialist Katya runs into her competitive childhood friend Lilya and impulsively claims she is getting married in a month.

scenes.title: The Fake Ultrasound
scenes.summary: At the clinic, Eva bribes an ultrasound doctor named Edik to convince Chef Barinov and Lyova that she is truly two weeks pregnant.

scenes.title: An Apartment Near Work
scenes.summary: Outside the clinic, Eva hints to a worried Chef Barinov that riding the metro is hard on pregnant women and asks him to rent her an apartment near the restaurant.

scenes.title: The Piano Lesson
scenes.summary: Restaurant owner Dmitry Nagiyev summons Denis to the grand piano and orders him to teach him a romantic piece by the day after tomorrow to impress a female pianist.

scenes.title: Searching for a Fiancé
scenes.summary: After imagining Senya and Louis failing as her fake fiancé, Katya asks Denis to pose as her groom for dinner with her friend while Denis continues teaching Nagiyev piano.

scenes.title: Vera Ivanovna's Advice
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov visits Lyova's mother Vera Ivanovna pretending to ask for advice about a friend who got an acquaintance pregnant, and she immediately assumes the father is Lyova.
scenes.location: Квартира Макса и Кости / Квартира Вики

scenes.title: Potato Chips and Four Hands
scenes.summary: At home, Lyova thinks his mother caught him eating forbidden potato chips until she mentions a baby, while at the restaurant Denis teaches Nagiyev to play piano in four hands.
scenes.location: Квартира Макса и Кости / Квартира Вики

scenes.title: Invitation to the Theater
scenes.summary: German invites Vika to go to the theater with him that evening after his aunt falls ill, while in the kitchen Katya drills Denis on their fake engagement story.

scenes.title: A New Apartment for Eva
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov surprises Eva with the keys to a rented apartment five minutes from the restaurant, and as he drives her to work she boldly asks him to buy her a car.
scenes.location: Квартира Макса и Кости / Квартира Вики

scenes.title: Father and Daughter Quarrel
scenes.summary: Waiting outside the restaurant, Katya overhears Eva and Chef Barinov talking about their baby and angrily confronts her father for abandoning his family when she needed him.

scenes.title: The Suit from Voronezh
scenes.summary: Denis steps outside in an absurd shiny suit from Voronezh just as German leaves Katya in charge of the kitchen, forcing Katya to invite her friend to dine at Claude Monet instead.

scenes.title: The Head-Chef Fiancé
scenes.summary: Katya introduces Denis in a head-chef jacket as her fiancé to Lilya and Ernest, and when Nagiyev orders Denis to play the grand piano for his date, Denis dedicates the song to Katya's guests.

scenes.title: Playing in Four Hands
scenes.summary: Nagiyev spots Denis in a head-chef uniform and joins him at the piano for their four-hands duet while Lyova proposes marriage to Eva, and Nagiyev's tipsy date insists on taking Denis home with them.

scenes.title: Exposed in the Dining Room
scenes.summary: Furious that his date is flirting with Denis, Nagiyev orders Denis back to the kitchen and publicly exposes that Denis is not the real head chef when Lilya asks for a photograph.

scenes.title: The Doctor's Confession
scenes.summary: Arriving at Eva's apartment at the same time, Chef Barinov and Lyova catch the ultrasound doctor Edik leaving and force him to confess that Eva paid him to fake her pregnancy.
scenes.location: Квартира Макса и Кости / Квартира Вики

scenes.title: Life in a Minor Key
scenes.summary: At the empty restaurant bar after her humiliation, Katya laments that she only attracts freaks and losers, and Denis sits at the piano to show her why she sees life in a minor key.

scenes.title: A Song in a Major Key
scenes.summary: Denis sings two improvised versions of Katya's troubles at the piano—first in a gloomy minor key and then in a cheerful major key—making Katya laugh and forget her embarrassment.

scenes.title: The Lucky Ticket
scenes.summary: German politely declines Vika's late-night coffee invitation after the theater, while Denis and Katya buy chocolate ice cream on an evening walk and share their first kiss.
